narrative.details:
Ah, adventurer! I just received word from Carendin Halgar that he would like to see you for further training.

You should be proud of yourself, adventurer. It's not every day that Master Halgar personally sees fit to instruct a young warlock.

You'll be able to find him in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, near the Temple of the Damned.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Carendin Halgar in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText: Good, I see Ageron managed to find you, adventurer. Let us waste little time with small talk and pleasantries and focus on your training. There is still much you have to learn.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 10, 1,460 XP in all.

quests.name: Halgar's Summons
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Carendin Halgar in the Undercity.

quests.name: Creature of the Void
quests.objectiveText: Recover Egalin's Grimoire and bring it to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.

quests.name: The Binding
quests.objectiveText: Using the Runes of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Runes of Summoning to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
